name: @msout/runner
description: Runner sidecar: the only component that sees the credential bytes. Spawns the unmodified @msout packages for one session at a time.

engines.comment: Same floor as the api and for the same reason: node:sqlite is built in from 22.13.0 unflagged. The runner does not use SQLite today, but a floor that is lower than another component's for no stated reason is a floor that will be quoted as precedent.

overridesComment: esbuild is pinned to 0.25.x, the version the api's lockfile already resolves. Without this, npm hoists esbuild 0.28.2 at the top level and then tries to install its @esbuild/aix-ppc64 optional dependency on linux/arm64, which fails with EBADPLATFORM — so `npm ci` cannot complete in the image and the build dies before it reaches any of this file's own checks. tsx and vitest both accept 0.25; nothing needs 0.28. The api resolved 0.25.x only because it has no top-level esbuild of its own, and a runner that pins archiver pulls a different hoisting outcome out of the same tsx.
